questions.question: Describe your experience preparing relay settings and electrical drawings for substation equipment. How did you verify that your one-line diagrams, schematics, and interconnection drawings were accurate?
In your medium-voltage circuit breaker simulator project at Siemens, what functions did the simulator replicate, how was it interfaced with the panel under test, and what test cases did it enable?

This role involves DFMEA/FMEA reviews. Using your circuit breaker simulator or substation engineering work as an example, how would you identify failure modes, determine their effects and causes, and prioritize mitigation actions?
What experience do you have reviewing electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, or hardware designs for potential faults before equipment is built or tested?

Explain how you would plan and execute design-verification testing for a medium-voltage electrical panel or circuit-breaker-related hardware update. What requirements, instrumentation, test cases, and acceptance criteria would you define?
Which laboratory instruments have you used—such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and signal generators—and how have you used them to troubleshoot or validate an electrical or digital system?

Describe a situation in which a test result or design issue required you to update a hardware design, drawing, configuration, or relay setting. How did you identify the issue and confirm the update resolved it?

The role includes WCCA updates and reviews. What is your understanding of worst-case circuit analysis, and how would you evaluate component tolerances, supply variation, temperature, and operating limits for a circuit?

In your Verilog projects, including matrix and integer multiplication, how did you verify functional correctness and handle issues such as bit width, signed two's-complement arithmetic, timing, or edge cases?
When supporting a DFMEA review or hardware V&V activity with engineers from different disciplines, how would you communicate test evidence, open risks, and recommended corrective actions?
